# hostd_os_images (Data Source)

OS images available for new VMs in a project. The list comes from the project's cluster, so image names cannot be guessed; use one of them as `os_image` of `hostd_vm`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostd_os_images" "available" {
  project_id = hostd_project.main.id
}

output "os_images" {
  value = data.hostd_os_images.available.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project (`hostd_project`).

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Image names, sorted, e.g. `debian-12-amd64.qcow2`.
